newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's BTKD and STUSID banks swap heads.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's BTKD and STUSID banks swap heads.

text.p: Tunisian-Kuwaiti Development Bank BTKD and Societe Tuniso-Saoudienne d'Investissement et de Developpement STUSID have swapped their heads, banking sources said on Tuesday.
They said Abdelmajid Frej passes from STUSID to BTKD and Abdelghaffar Ezzeddine goes the other way.
Both represent the Tunisian state in the two banks specialised in the financing of Tunisian development projects.
STUSID has a capital of 100 million dinars, 50 percent of which was subscribed by the Saudi Arabian state and the other 50 percent by the Tunisian state and local public funds and firms.
BTKD has a capital of 100 million dinars equally shared by the Tunisian state and the Kuwaiti state and other public funds. ($=0.97 dinar)
